name: weibo-agent-dashboard
description: Free-first personal Weibo content dashboard with a whitelisted Weibo CLI bridge.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/weibo-bridge && concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/weibo-bridge && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
